name: Online Object Tracking Benchmark (OTB)
description: Evaluates single-object visual tracking algorithms on a standardized set of annotated video sequences using common tracking metrics.
general_score_metric: success_rate (AUC of overlap / IoU) and precision (center location error)
notes: Legacy, relatively small dataset; widely used historically but increasingly saturated by modern trackers. Not an LLM benchmark; care needed for overfitting to a small set of short sequences and limited scenario diversity.
